items.source: Gets the appropriate CSS class to use based on the state of the current BindStatus object.
items.translation: 根据当前 BindStatus 对象的状态，获取要使用的适当 CSS 类。

items.source:
The CSS class to use when the field bound to a particular tag has errors.
May be a runtime expression.
items.translation:
绑定到特定标签的字段存在错误时使用的 CSS 类。
可以是运行时表达式。

items.source: Additionally, this base class allows for rendering non-standard attributes as part of the tag's output. These attributes are accessible to subclasses if needed via the dynamicAttributes map.
items.translation: 此外，该基类允许将非标准属性作为标签输出的一部分进行渲染。如果子类需要访问这些属性，可以通过dynamicAttributes映射来获取。

items.source: Writes the optional attributes configured via this base class to the supplied TagWriter. The set of optional attributes that will be rendered includes any non-standard dynamic attributes. Called by writeDefaultAttributes(TagWriter).
items.translation: 将本基类配置的可选属性写入提供的 `TagWriter`。 要渲染的可选属性集包括任何非标准动态属性。 由 `writeDefaultAttributes(TagWriter)` 调用。

items.source: Writes the default attributes configured via this base class to the supplied TagWriter.
items.translation: 将本基类配置的默认属性写入提供的 `TagWriter`。

items.source: Writes the optional attributes configured via this base class to the supplied TagWriter.
items.translation: 将本基类配置的可选属性写入提供的TagWriter。

items.source: Writes the default attributes configured via this base class to the supplied TagWriter. Subclasses should call this when they want the base attribute set to be written to the output.
items.translation: 将通过此基类配置的默认属性写入提供的 TagWriter。子类在希望将基本属性写入输出时，应调用此方法。
